definitions.longest_miss_duration_ms: consecutive missed 5ms grids times 5; not a separately measured actuator outage
definitions.native_step_record_ms: plant step plus native evidence record through host_step_finish; excludes later safety monitor and 5ms capture
definitions.poll_end_to_next_tick_start_ms: main-loop wall gap containing task/reference/control/safety/log work and possible OS pauses; not isolated CPU cost
definitions.poll_to_next_poll_ms: wall interval including main work, catchup, sleep and scheduling
definitions.sample_materialization_age_ms: host materialization minus scheduled source capture
definitions.io_lock_limit: active-epoch I/O and lock durations are not directly instrumented; request queue/wait and GC callbacks are observed
